answer: Because the vertex derivation is checked against the raven nonce, the delta audit keeps the accepted values and a reused text fails on the first character. That binds the text to one identity's challenge, so copying between 20 aliases produces 20 mismatches and forfeits the authoring cost with no payout. An answer must include the first 10 hex characters of the seed it was derived under, and a wrong or missing derivation is rejected at intake. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
